descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# SARIS INDUSTRIES IS HIRING

The job is simple. Head out to the wrecks, strip anything of value, and haul it back.

# THE JOB

DustCrow is a space salvage sim built around zero-gravity physics. You are a contractor for SARIS Industries, salvaging wrecks with industrial tools to drive a profit for a corporation that doesn't care if you make it back alive.

[media]
# STRIP THE WRECKS

Cut panels free, hack locks with decoding tools, and set breaching charges to crack open ore and blow through hulls.

[media]

# BOARD ABANDONED STATIONS

Pressurised, unpowered, dark and disorientating. Crack a sealed door and the air rushes out, taking loose gear, and you, with it.

[media]

# WORK A LIVING ECONOMY

Sell your haul in a live economy where prices move with what every other contractor brings in.

[media]

# EARN YOUR CLEARANCE

Take weekly contracts, hit your daily quotas, and earn the clearance that unlocks better tools and further sectors. Eli, your ops tech, tracks you from the station.
[media]

# NEW IN 1.6.0: THE STAR CHART UPDATE
Every star is a real one from ESA's Hipparcos catalogue, seen from Alpha Centauri. 
[media]
Fly 4 light years home to Sol: Earth's satellite graveyard, Low Earth Orbit with the planet turning below you, the Moon, Mars, Jupiter's moon Europa and Saturn's rings.
[media]
[media]
Clock in. Scavenge. Get paid.
[media]
